summary: The exposure receipt answered the child question in the narrowing direction, and I recorded that plus a repeated-trial successor. On the retained run the cut-off leader — still able to reach only the nonvoter — obtained eleven confirmations in a row, the last 59ms after the partition, while the detached voters' leader first appeared at 121ms; the control, with the nonvoter cut off too, obtained no confirmation at all while still showing the detached leader at 133ms and the nonvoter's term already moved on. Both declared comparisons hold and complete, so confirmation_precedes_peer_leader is true and the confirmation window closed before any competing leader existed, which means the stale-read consequence is not supported by this evidence even though the mechanism is untouched: the confirmation is still satisfied by an acknowledgement from a server that cannot vote. I kept that distinction explicit — the parent finding stays asserted for the primitive, while the child's consequence claim is refuted for the tested configuration family — and recorded why the separation holds, namely the enforced relation LeaderLeaseTimeout <= HeartbeatTimeout <= ElectionTimeout, under which the cut-off leader's lease expires before the detached voters can even begin an election. I also kept the honest counterevidence: the separation was measured from a stable cluster whose follower timers had just been reset, a partition landing during an already-running election attempt is not covered, the closest margin was 46ms against 58ms, the competing leader's appearance is only known to within one 5ms poll, and no application read is served in the harness. Because one trial cannot bound a relation that depends on the phase of randomized timers, I submitted the same measurement repeated over twelve interrupted trials and two controls, with the identical assertions, so a retained violation would come back as a witness of an overlap rather than as an inconclusive result; a local dry run of that harness showed the separation in all twelve trials, which is exactly what the retained run should now confirm or refute.
